items.title: Danny Barker — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The one that got killed. ... Bunk went out there to play with his band. Bunk was supposed to be there the night when he got killed. That’s all hearsay.

ctx.x: Bunk. The story goes that the guy came after he stabbed . . .
. . . Evan Thomas. I think his name was something like John Gibley, or something like that, and he came back . . .

items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: Evan Thomas. The Black Eagle Band. It was a helluva band. They used to come to New Orleans occasionally.

ctx.x: Evan Thomas. The Black Eagle Band. It was a helluva band. They used to come to New Orleans occasionally. And Evan Thomas was going out with some cat's old lady. Cats went to the penitentiary and told... It was a freaky thing, like a country club down there, the penitentiary shit, you know...
